title: Capricorn Sends Minutes
old_caption: Capricorn wrote meeting notes about a tiny argument and sent them. Petty, beautifully formatted. The real ask was simpler: please plan something for once.

title: Sagittarius Posts a Quote
old_caption: The vague quote about freedom after a small bicker? Petty. Needing a night alone? Valid. Wanting your big plan taken seriously? Very valid, so tell them. Which sign posts the quote in your group chat?

title: Aries Is Not Cold
old_caption: "I'm not even cold," says the Aries, shivering, clearly hoping for your jacket. Then they skip the act and just say it: I like you, a lot. Who's your shivering Aries?

title: Scorpio Says Fine
old_caption: When a Scorpio says fine, it has usually been thinking about it for nine hours. When it says interesting, it is obsessed. When it asks where you're going, believe it.

title: Pisces Is Not Crying
old_caption: Pisces is not crying. Pisces is crying, because the song is nice. Pisces has also already imagined your whole winter together. Tell us you know a Pisces without telling us.

title: Capricorn Is Just Busy
old_caption: "Just busy this week" means Friday is already cleared for you. "Let's be practical" means the plant has a name. Capricorn's heart was never off the clock.

title: Aquarius Is Not a Romance Person
old_caption: "Not really a romance person," says the Aquarius who drew you a star map by hand. Translation available on request. Which line has an air sign said to you?

title: The Taurus Nests
old_caption: Observed in the cold months: a Taurus gathering every blanket in the house and guarding the snacks with one eye open. The rare part is the sharing, and it was caught on film.

title: The Gemini in the Wild
old_caption: Here we see the Gemini, keeping three conversations in the air at once. Its call: wait, what? And then, very rarely, it lands and listens. Narrated as quietly as possible.

title: The Cancer Hosts
old_caption: The Cancer builds a shell of pillows and feeds every visitor. Every one. What the cameras almost never catch: someone bringing the Cancer a cookie for once. Who hosts your friend group?
